thesis: Every card that moves is billed twice — Brallin taxes the half of a wheel that LEAVES the hand and Shabraz taxes the half that ARRIVES — and fourteen more permanents stand at one of those two tollbooths, three of them only once a turn.

stages.label: THIRTY-NINE SOURCES, TWO PRICES
stages.what_it_does: Thirty-six lands plus Sol Ring, Arcane Signet and Treasure Map // Treasure Cove. It pays for a 4- or 5-mana commander and then a 3-to-6-mana wheel on top, which is why mean available mana matters more here than any single land: 4.015 at turn four, 5.482 at turn six, 9.237 at turn ten, with the land drop hit at 0.810 on turn four and 0.698 on turn six. The map splits the landbase and the split is real, not an artefact: every land that charges LIFE TO TAP (City of Brass, Mana Confluence, Spire of Industry, Adarkar Wastes, Battlefield Forge, Shivan Reef), every any-colour source, and every land with a non-mana ability (Reliquary Tower, Talon Gates of Madara, Raugrin Triome, Opal Palace, Gemstone Caverns, Calciform Pools) is in THE FIXERS; not one of the twenty-two in COLOUR ON CURVE does any of those things. The line the split draws is RECURRING PER TAP against ONE-OFF ON ENTRY, not free against costly — three of the twenty-two (Hallowed Fountain, Sacred Foundry, Steam Vents) pay 2 life as they enter and nothing thereafter. Two of the fixers are doing engine work a land has no business doing — Reliquary Tower is one third of the declared hand-size relief, and Raugrin Triome's cycling is a discard that pays Brallin. Both stay here because a land you must play on curve is mana first.

evidence.note: COLOUR ON CURVE, 22 lands, none charging life to tap
THE FIXERS, 14 lands: every life-tap, every any-colour source, every non-mana ability
Sol Ring, Arcane Signet and Treasure Map cluster in FUND THE NEXT WHEEL with the Treasure makers

stages.label: A WHEEL RESOLVING
stages.what_it_does: The declaration's ignition component, seventeen cards (deck-audit, size 17). Sixteen of them move a WHOLE hand at once; Burning Inquiry is the exception and is named rather than smoothed over — 'each player draws three cards, then discards three cards at random' is a fixed three, the same shape as Faithless Looting, which this model files in fuel as an outlet. It sits in the component because deck-audit's own list puts it there. Ignition is the first thing that has to happen, and it is this deck's LEAST fragile stage: both commanders are guaranteed from the command zone (Brallin's mean cast turn 4.255, both partners online by turn six 82.0%), while a wheel is drawn by turn six 94.7% of the time at mean turn 1.735 and sits in 74.5% of opening sevens. Any account that calls the wheel the bottleneck is wrong. Nine of the seventeen make you DISCARD, which is the half Brallin bills; the other eight shuffle or bottom the hand instead and pay him nothing (Arjun, Commit // Memory, Echo of Eons, Molten Psyche, Teferi's Puzzle Box, Time Reversal, Whirlpool Warrior, Winds of Change). The discard nine are drawn by turn six 82.1% of the time. A wheel with no tollbooth on the battlefield is just a new hand — the stage after this one is what makes it an engine.

evidence.note: all 17 sit in THE WHEELS; the city holds 6 more cards that do not wheel

stages.label: CARD MOVEMENT BETWEEN WHEELS, AND THE MANA FOR THE NEXT ONE
stages.what_it_does: A wheel is a burst; these keep cards moving on the turns there is no wheel, and pay for the one after. Outlets you buy a discard from, one card at a time, with mana: Faithless Looting, Jaxis ({R}, {T}, discard) and Mindless Automaton ({1}, discard). Artist's Talent is NOT one of those — its level-1 loot costs no mana and is gated on casting a noncreature spell. Ceremonial Knife is not one either: it is an Equipment whose Blood arrives only 'whenever this creature deals COMBAT damage', so it wants {1} to cast, {2} to equip, a creature, an attack and a connection — and the goldfish states that Blood made by connecting in combat is read and NOT credited, so the Knife moves no figure anywhere in this artifact. Draw supply that keeps the tollbooths paid: Rhystic Study, Mind's Eye, Enduring Curiosity, Sorcerer Class, and Teferi's Ageless Insight, which doubles every draw except the first one in each draw step (its only measurement is an uncommitted sweep — see lines and notes). And Treasure that funds a second spell the same turn: Smothering Tithe, Generous Plunderer, Sticky Fingers — all unpriced, `model_treasures` is OFF. Library of Leng is here because it is what stops the cleanup step taking the wheel's seven back. Marketback Walker is here and NOT in the air kill: no combat trigger, no evasion, and its only engine contact is 'when this creature dies, draw a card for each +1/+1 counter on it' — a deferred draw burst that first requires it to die, and model-coverage reads the card on the `bodies` channel alone. The goldfish emits ONE DECK-WIDE series and no per-stage split, so no figure belongs to this stage alone.

evidence.note: 4 of 15 in FUND THE NEXT WHEEL
4 of 15 in WHAT THE DRAWS BUY
Artist's Talent, Faithless Looting and Teferi's Ageless Insight cluster with THE WHEELS on their draw/discard wording without being wheels
Mindless Automaton and Marketback Walker sit in BODIES THAT GROW; the map reads both as bodies, and both are in this stage for a card-movement clause instead

stages.label: THE TOLLBOOTHS THAT PAY IN BOARD AND CARDS
stages.what_it_does: Eleven permanents that read 'whenever you draw' or 'whenever you discard'. Nine pay in counters, bodies or more cards; TWO are here for their trigger rather than their payout — Curator of Mysteries pays in scry 1, which is selection and not advantage, and Currency Converter's discard trigger pays nothing at all by itself. CADENCE is what to read here, not the count: The Locust God makes an Insect per card and Chasm Skulker and Shabraz take a counter per card, while Improbable Alliance makes ONE Faerie however many a wheel draws ('whenever you draw your second card each turn'), Rielle fires only on the first discard each turn but draws that many, so a seven-card wheel is seven cards, and Ominous Seas banks a counter per draw and pays nothing until eight. Ivora is a second Brallin on the discard half (a counter per discard) and she makes her own fodder; the swap decision record (branches/ivora-v1/branch.json, staged[0].why) reports an UNCOMMITTED decomposition sweep, stating no arms, seed or game count and so carrying no sha: Blood alone -0.026 damage@8, counter trigger alone +0.305, the two together +0.817, against that sweep's own stated MDE of 0.564. Only +0.817 clears it; 'the token feeds the trigger' is the record's reading. Drake Haven turns a discard into a 2/2 for {1}. Containment Construct recovers the discarded card itself (exile it from the graveyard, play it this turn); Currency Converter does NOT — its trigger only exiles, and a separate {T} turns one exiled card per tap into a Treasure if it was a land or a 2/2 Rogue if it was not. This stage is where the board comes from: mean bodies 2.280 at turn six and 7.202 at turn ten, mean board power 18.334 at turn ten, mean commander counters 32.765 at turn ten.

evidence.note: 3 of 11 in WHAT THE DRAWS BUY
Shabraz, Ivora and Chasm Skulker in BODIES THAT GROW; Brallin is in the same city but is in the output stage

stages.label: THE TOLLBOOTHS THAT PAY IN DAMAGE
stages.what_it_does: The same tollbooths, billing in life totals instead of board. Brallin is the whole discard half: one damage to EACH opponent per card discarded, so a seven-card wheel is seven to each of three seats. Glint-Horn Buccaneer is the only other per-discard damage source in the 99 and doubles that ping. Psychosis Crawler and Niv-Mizzet bill EVERY draw; Irencrag Pyromancer is on a different clock — 'whenever you draw your second card each turn' is one 3-damage trigger a wheel, not seven — and grouping the three as one rate would overstate it. Astral Drift was in this stage in the previous model and has been WITHDRAWN: it exiles a creature and returns it at the beginning of the next end step, which is a blink and not removal. Read the figures with their convention: the goldfish counts ONE opponent at 40 life, and `discard.mean_cumulative_event_damage_by_turn['10']` = 13.22 is the WHOLE event-damage pillar in one accumulator — every per-discard AND per-draw payoff together — not Brallin's share, which the model does not decompose. THE WHEEL KILL target reads 0.787 assembled, 0.460 by turn six, mean turn 5.467. This stage has NO single point of failure: deck-audit's one SPOF is scoped to the component 'A second per-discard DAMAGE source drawn' (size 1, 39.5% assembled, 18.4% by turn six), which is a redundancy gap in the DOUBLER. Brallin is a commander and is available every game, and three more payoffs remain without Glint-Horn.

evidence.note: Glint-Horn and Irencrag Pyromancer cluster with THE WHEELS (city-2-hood-1, BURN FROM THE REFILL); Brallin is in BODIES THAT GROW (city-3); Niv-Mizzet and Psychosis Crawler in WHAT THE DRAWS BUY (city-6). Five cards doing one job, three addresses.

stages.label: KEEPING THE TOLLBOOTH ON THE TABLE
stages.what_it_does: Two equipment that make a commander untargetable the turn it lands (Lightning Greaves' shroud, Swiftfoot Boots' hexproof), and Nezahal, which cannot be countered, removes your maximum hand size, and whose self-exile cost is itself three discards — three more Brallin triggers paid to dodge a removal spell. The two cycling answers are NOT the same answer: Decree of Silence's cycle trigger counters target SPELL, while Nimble Obstructionist's counters 'target activated or triggered ABILITY you don't control' and cannot touch a Swords to Plowshares, a Pongify or a wrath — which is the threat this stage exists to price. The declaration inherits the same conflation: its 'A real answer drawn' group is Commit // Memory, Decree of Silence and Nimble Obstructionist (74.6% assembled, 46.6% by turn six). Astral Drift is here rather than in output because it is a BLINK: 'you may exile target creature ... return that card to the battlefield ... at the beginning of the next end step' removes nothing, and its use on your own creature in response to a targeted spell costs a commander every +1/+1 counter it had. The goldfish lists it in meta.interaction_suite_counted, which records what was counted, not that it answers anything. The declared protection group is thin and measured thin: two cards, 61.9% assembled, 35.4% by turn six, mean turn 5.333. Held-up interaction is worse and the model says so — interaction castable 0.083 on turn six and 0.125 on turn eight while 0.525 of hands HOLD an answer, because this model spends every mana it has. A floor, not a verdict.

evidence.note: 5 of 6 in CARD BY CARD (Decree and Nimble Obstructionist together in city-0-hood-1, CYCLED NOT CAST; Astral Drift in city-0-hood-0); Nezahal clusters with THE WHEELS on its hand-size and draw wording

stages.label: THE AIR KILL, AND WHO CARRIES THE COUNTERS
stages.what_it_does: The declaration names two kills and they share one ignition. The WHEEL KILL is the output stage stacking pings; this stage is the AIR KILL — evasive bodies that grow on every card and fly over. Shark Typhoon, Vanguard Suppressor and Kefnet the Mindful fly; Silent Hallcreeper cannot be blocked; Stromkirk Noble, Waterbender Ascension and Gossip's Talent are the connect-and-grow support that makes the rest get through — three, not the four the previous model named. Marketback Walker is WITHDRAWN from this stage and filed in fuel: its whole text is an {X}{X} body, a {4} counter and a death-draw, with no combat trigger, no evasion and nothing that helps anything through. The map already draws that line — city-3-hood-1 PAID ON CONNECTION against city-3-hood-0 COUNTERS WITHOUT COMBAT. The two commanders are the real finishers and they enable each other in a way no cluster shows: Shabraz's {W/U} gives a HUMAN flying and Brallin is a Human Shaman; Brallin's {R} gives a SHARK trample and Shabraz is a Shark Bird. Two 3/3s carrying 32.765 counters between them by turn ten, each granting the other the keyword it lacks. Measured clock, unopposed and against one seat: kill by turn seven 61.9%, by turn eight 87.3%, median turn 7, mean 7.268.

evidence.note: 4 of 7 in BODIES THAT GROW (Silent Hallcreeper, Stromkirk Noble, Waterbender Ascension, Gossip's Talent); Kefnet the Mindful and Vanguard Suppressor in WHAT THE DRAWS BUY (city-6); Shark Typhoon in CARD BY CARD (city-0)

lines.note: CLAIM, no passing stack. Seven cards discarded is seven separate Brallin triggers: seven damage to EACH opponent and Brallin at 10/10. NO FIGURE PRICES THIS PAIR ALONE — the goldfish accumulates every per-discard and per-draw payoff into one series, so 13.22 (discard.mean_cumulative_event_damage_by_turn['10'], one 40-life seat) is the whole event-damage pillar and not this pair's share.

CLAIM, no passing stack. Both read 'whenever you discard a card', so the same seven discards bill twice. deck-audit's one single point of failure is this second source, scoped to the component 'A second per-discard DAMAGE source drawn' (size 1): 39.5% assembled, 18.4% by turn six.

CLAIM, no passing stack. The doubler applies to every draw except the first in a draw step, so a wheel's seven becomes fourteen and Shabraz takes fourteen counters. The only measurement of the card is an UNCOMMITTED sweep run during the swap decision and recorded as prose in branches/ivora-v1/branch.json (staged[1].why): control = this 99 with Elesh Norn cut and nothing added, arm = the same list plus Teferi's Ageless Insight, 10,000 games, seed 17 — mean_extra_cards_drawn_by_turn['10'] 16.948 → 19.894 (+2.95) and mean_commander_counters_by_turn['10'] 28.582 → 32.386 (+3.80). Neither arm is a committed decklist, so these figures carry NO artifact sha; the previous model stamped one on them and that stamp is withdrawn.
CLAIM, no passing stack. Rielle's 'first discard each turn' fires once on the whole seven and draws seven, which then pays every per-draw tollbooth a second time on the same wheel.

CLAIM, no passing stack. Cracking a Blood token discards a card and draws one: a Brallin ping plus counter, an Ivora counter and a Shabraz counter from one activation. The swap decision record (branches/ivora-v1/branch.json, staged[0].why) reports an uncommitted decomposition sweep in damage@8 deltas: Blood alone -0.026, which sits under that sweep's stated MDE of 0.564, and Blood plus trigger +0.817, which clears it. The record states no arms, seed or game count and the figures carry no artifact sha. Only the +0.817 is resolvable.

CLAIM, no passing stack. Artist's Talent level 3 adds 2 to noncombat damage a source you control deals an opponent; Brallin's per-discard ping is noncombat damage to each opponent, so a seven-card wheel would read 21 a seat instead of 7. It is not cheap or fast: {1}{R} to cast, then {2}{R} and {2}{R} at sorcery speed to reach level 3 before any of it happens. Unpriced — Artist's Talent is invisible to the goldfish.

CLAIM, no passing stack, and the one most worth checking. Library of Leng changes where a discarded card goes, not whether it was discarded; if that is right, a wheel pays Brallin its full count and you keep the cards on top of your library. Note its scope: 'if an EFFECT causes you to discard', which does not reach a discard paid as a COST — cycling, a Blood crack, Jaxis — so whichever way it goes it applies to the wheel and not to the self-discard channel.
CLAIM, no passing stack. A symmetrical wheel makes three opponents draw seven each; every one of those 21 draws is a Treasure unless that player pays 2. Entirely unpriced: model_treasures is OFF.

CLAIM, no passing stack. The conversion half makes the damage half evasive and the damage half makes the conversion half trample: Shabraz's {W/U} targets a Human and Brallin is a Human Shaman; Brallin's {R} targets a Shark and Shabraz is a Shark Bird. 32.765 commander counters by turn ten sit on two 3/3s that can each give the other the keyword it lacks.

CLAIM, no passing stack. The air kill's bodies are made by the draw half, not cast: every card drawn is a 1/1 flying haste Insect off The Locust God, and Shark Typhoon cycles for an X/X flier at instant speed. Declared AIR KILL: 82.1% assembled, 53.5% by turn six, mean turn 4.871.

map_disagreements.component: THE WHEELS (city-2) is not the ignition stage
map_disagreements.why: All 17 wheels are in city-2, but city-2 holds 23 cards. The six extras cluster there on WORDING, not job, and in two different ways. Artist's Talent ('you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card') and Faithless Looting ('Draw two cards, then discard two cards') say draw-and-discard without moving a hand. Teferi's Ageless Insight says no such thing — 'If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead' has no discard clause anywhere — and clusters on the draw wording alone. Glint-Horn Buccaneer, Irencrag Pyromancer and Nezahal say it while being tollbooths or protection. Reading the city as the engine's first stage over-counts ignition by six.

map_disagreements.component: The damage tollbooths have three addresses
map_disagreements.why: Brallin, Glint-Horn, Irencrag Pyromancer, Niv-Mizzet and Psychosis Crawler do one job — convert a card moving into a life total going down — and land in three cities, because the map reads what each card's trigger CONDITION is (a discard, a second draw) rather than what it pays out. This is the deck's clock and it is invisible as a group on the map. The previous model counted four addresses by including Astral Drift, which is not a damage source at all.

map_disagreements.component: The partners are split across two stages and one city
map_disagreements.why: Shabraz and Brallin sit together in city-3, correctly — both are commanders that grow on card movement. Functionally they are two different machines: Shabraz taxes the arriving half and pays in counters and life (conversion), Brallin taxes the leaving half and pays in damage (output). The city cannot show that, and it is the single most important thing to know about piloting the deck.

map_disagreements.component: SEVEN cards discard themselves and the map scatters them
map_disagreements.why: Enumerated from cards.json by the word 'cycling': Astral Drift, Decree of Silence, Nimble Obstructionist, Ominous Seas and Shark Typhoon in CARD BY CARD, Curator of Mysteries in WHAT THE DRAWS BUY, Raugrin Triome in THE FIXERS — seven, not the six the previous model listed, which missed Ominous Seas' cycling {2}. Every one is a card that cycles itself, which is a discard that pays Brallin and a draw that pays Shabraz at instant speed with no wheel. They are clustered on what they do WHEN cycled, which is seven different things. The goldfish does not model cycling at all, so this whole channel is absent from every figure here.

map_disagreements.component: COLOUR ON CURVE and THE FIXERS are one mana stage but a real split
map_disagreements.why: Both cities are the landbase, so the mana stage cuts across them — but they are NOT an arbitrary division, and any account saying so is wrong on membership. Every land in the deck that charges life TO TAP, every any-colour source, and every land with a non-mana ability is in THE FIXERS; zero of the twenty-two in COLOUR ON CURVE does any of those. The split is recurring-per-tap against one-off-on-entry rather than cost against no cost: Hallowed Fountain, Sacred Foundry and Steam Vents sit in COLOUR ON CURVE and each pays 2 life as it ENTERS, then nothing. That is still a distinction a pilot uses every turn and a stage boundary cannot express.

open_questions.question: Does Library of Leng's replacement — putting a discarded card on top of your library instead of into the graveyard — still trigger Brallin's 'whenever you discard a card'? If it does, a wheel under Library of Leng pays its full damage AND leaves the cards on top.
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the difference between Library of Leng being hand-size insurance and being the best card in the deck. Every damage figure for the wheel kill changes if this is wrong.

open_questions.question: Resolve a stack for the base line: a seven-card discard wheel with Brallin on the battlefield. Confirm that each card discarded is a separate trigger, that the damage is dealt to each opponent per trigger, and that the counters are on Brallin before the refill draws resolve.
open_questions.why_it_matters: This deck has ZERO passing stacks and zero verified pairings. Every line in this artifact is a claim; this is the one that must be a fact first, because six of the other eight depend on it.

open_questions.question: Does Artist's Talent level 3 ('if a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage plus 2') apply per Brallin trigger, making a seven-card wheel 21 damage a seat rather than 7?
open_questions.why_it_matters: If it does, Artist's Talent is the deck's largest damage multiplier and it is currently INVISIBLE to the goldfish, so no figure in this artifact reflects it.

open_questions.question: Confirm the partner keyword grants: Shabraz's '{W/U}: Target Human gains flying' legally targets Brallin (Human Shaman) and Brallin's '{R}: Target Shark gains trample' legally targets Shabraz (Shark Bird).
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the whole air kill. Two 3/3s with 32.765 counters between them by turn ten only close a game if they are evasive, and the deck's answer is that each partner fixes the other.

open_questions.question: Re-run the Teferi's Ageless Insight measurement as a COMMITTED sweep: control = the current 99 with the Insight cut, arm = the current 99, same seed and game count. The +2.95 extra cards / +3.80 commander counters pair exists only as prose in branches/ivora-v1/branch.json and was measured against a baseline list that is committed nowhere.
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the only figure attached to either card bought on 2026-09-14, and a measurement no artifact can carry a sha for is one nothing downstream can re-derive or invalidate. model-coverage now reports the card `seen` on the `draw` channel (the mirror drift was fixed in commit a8c77df3), so the harness can price it.

open_questions.question: Re-run with model_treasures and model_sacrifice ON. Five of the seven declared ramp cards make Treasure, Generous Plunderer is DARK on the treasure channel, Treasure Map // Treasure Cove is DARK on sacrifice, and Smothering Tithe off a symmetrical wheel is potentially the deck's largest single mana event.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Every mana figure in the mana and fuel stages is a floor by an unknown amount, and the deck's ability to cast a second wheel the same turn rests entirely on the unpriced channel.

open_questions.question: How much is the deck losing by handing three opponents a fresh seven every wheel? The goldfish prices the tax and explicitly does not price the cost — it has no opponent turn and no opponent board.
open_questions.why_it_matters: A symmetrical wheel deck's real risk is the refill it gives a combo seat. Nothing in this artifact's figures can see it, and the answer decides whether the eight non-discard wheels are worth their slots at all.

notes: NO FACT TIER. engine-facts reports 0 verified pairings across 0 passing stacks, 0 load-bearing cards and 0 candidate combo lines. Every entry in `lines` is the analyst's reading, carries verified_by: null, and has a matching entry in open_questions.

Stage completeness: 100 of 100 cards placed, none unassigned. Counts: mana 39, ignition 17, fuel 15, conversion 11, output 5, protection 6, wincon 7. Two cards have moved across revisions: Astral Drift from output to protection (it is a blink, not removal), and Marketback Walker from wincon to fuel (no combat trigger and no evasion, so it is not part of the air kill).

NO FODDER STAGE. The resource this deck converts is its own hand, which is not a card class — there is no subset of the 99 whose job is to be eaten. The nearest thing is the SEVEN cards that cycle themselves, enumerated by regex over cards.json for 'Cycling': Astral Drift, Curator of Mysteries, Decree of Silence, Nimble Obstructionist, Ominous Seas, Raugrin Triome, Shark Typhoon. They are filed by what they do when cycled, which puts them in FOUR stages — protection (Astral Drift, Decree of Silence, Nimble Obstructionist), conversion (Curator of Mysteries, Ominous Seas), mana (Raugrin Triome) and wincon (Shark Typhoon). None is in fuel and none is in output; the previous model said six cards and named the wrong three stages. Manufacturing a fodder stage here would name a city, not an engine.

The goldfish counts ONE opponent at 40 life, so every per-opponent figure (Brallin, Glint-Horn, Psychosis Crawler) is a floor that roughly triples at a four-player table. It also does not model cycling, madness, or activated loots — the whole self-discard channel is absent, not zero.

Two cards were cut from the 99 on 2026-09-14 (Elesh Norn // The Argent Etchings, Goblin Engineer) and neither appears anywhere in this artifact. The run every figure here is read from is the post-cut one, at decklist_sha256 e512fc87f4. combat.mean_damage_by_turn is SETTLED as PER TURN: net_change.METRICS['damage @T10'] now states it — 'the clock at its tenth turn, not a running total' — because goldfish_turn resets `dealt` to 0 inside the turn loop before appending, and the event pillar carries both shapes by name while this row has only the per-turn one. So this deck's 31.290 and 53.904 are damage dealt ON turn eight and ON turn ten.
